dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple irregular 'O' and 'C' shaped light-colored perimeters on the posterior dorsal-lateral surface, showing sharp high-contrast transitions from dark charcoal background pixels to thin, light-grey annular boundaries with darker interior centers.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low density of solid pixel clusters; small, localized high-intensity pixel groups are visible on the muzzle and around the ocular orbits, with sparse, minute specks along the dorsal ridge line.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: An irregular triangular spatial relationship is formed by connecting the centroids of the three most prominent annular rings located on the mid-lateral flank of the body.

other_distinctive_markers: A significant, high-contrast light-tan region on the ventral-cervical area that terminates abruptly where the darker dorsal-lateral fur begins.
